insert overwrite table ${cdm_pt_prod}.dwd_ast_cust_eqty_cs_estim_df partition(dt = '${v_dt}' )
select
 id as key_id --'主键id' 
 ,account as cust_idtty_no --'客户证件号码' 
 ,work_order_number as order_no --'工单号' 
 ,value as estim_fraction --'评价分数' 
 ,remark as rmrk --'备注' 
 ,to_date(create_date
 ,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as put_tm --'入库时间' 
 ,sourcetype as estim_src_chnl --'评价来源渠道' 
 ,getdate() as fst_load_tm --'首次加载时间' 
 ,getdate() as lst_load_tm --'最后一次更新时间' 
 , 'pt17cccs' as load_fm --'来源系统' 
from ${ods_pt17cccs}.v_oracccs122_cccs_spms_customer_evaluation
where ds = '${v_dt}'
;
